plugins.name: pmcro
plugins.description: The PMCR-O loop as skills (/pmcro:seed, /pmcro:loop, /pmcro:frame, /pmcro:check, /pmcro:seal, /pmcro:replay, /pmcro:commit) and the company seats as agents (@<bot-id>). Generated from company.json.

plugins.name: pmcro-authoring
plugins.description: Author PMCR-O agent skills from templates: scaffold SKILL.md, references, scripts and assets, validate them, and hold each new skill as a proposal until it is approved or rejected.

plugins.name: pmcro-docker
plugins.description: Docker skills for PMCR-O trails: an engine baseline, a wrapper that logs every docker command into a trail, a .NET MCP server template, and a notebook test kit. No Docker build runs on the company PC until Shawn clears the hardware.

plugins.name: pmcro-docs
plugins.description: Documentation skills for the PMCR-O company: DocFX docs product and simulate, a dry run of a plan into a simulated trail without writing product files.

plugins.name: pmcro-github
plugins.description: GitHub templates and workflow skills for the PMCR-O loop: seed issue form, PR template, CODEOWNERS, and workflows that replay trails, check the plugin layout and turn a seed issue into a queue PR, always stopping at a human merge.
